The '''River Lands''' were an area located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], surrounded by the [[Old Muckworks]], the [[Drainage Isle]], the [[bog]] and the [[Rust Yards]]. The river itself was inhabited by infected and mutant [[chemilizard]]s.<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
[[Donal (Nal Hutta)|Donal's]] brother had a [[Donal's brother's farm|farmhouse]] in the River Lands until he was killed by [[Fa'athra gang|Fa'athra's goons]]. Around the same time, one of [[Suudaa Nem'ro|Nem'ro's]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was shot down over [[Voontara Fa'athra|Fa'athra]] airspace and crashed in the River Lands.<ref name="TOR" />
